scenes.label: LAST AWAKE
scenes.action: Impact throws the astronaut into the corridor wall. He braces, plants his feet, then runs toward the cockpit.

scenes.label: EARTH CONNECTION LOST
scenes.action: He reaches the cockpit, tries the dead navigation console and slams a failing restart button.

scenes.label: GOOD NEWS / BAD NEWS
scenes.action: Wangdoo waddles out of maintenance, waves, proudly presents his repaired coffee machine, then recoils at an electrical pop.

scenes.label: STORY MISSION 01 · RESTORE NAVIGATION
scenes.action: The astronaut kneels and holds a live cable while Wangdoo closes the switch. Sparks knock Wangdoo off balance; the astronaut catches him. The star map returns.

scenes.label: TWO SIGNALS
scenes.action: The window shutter rises. Wangdoo jumps and points toward a purple planet; the astronaut checks the station and planet signals.

scenes.label: ONE JUMP LEFT
scenes.action: A final power failure kills one route. The astronaut reaches for the selector, hesitates, then pulls his hand back.

scenes.label: YOU CHOOSE
scenes.action: Both characters study the two destinations. Wangdoo tugs the astronaut's sleeve and looks between the choices.

scenes.label: BUILD YOUR OWN JOURNEY
scenes.action: Compact voting choices remain above an authentic AltWing website insert and invitation to explore real projects.

dialogue.text: You're the last astronaut awake. And your ship is dying.
Earth hasn't responded in forty-seven days.
Bad news. Everything else is broken.
Hold that cable. I'll take the switch.
Two signals. Two possible ways to survive.
One jump. No return trip. Pick wisely.
Your choices shape their story. Build your own journey with AltWing.

scenes.label: THIS IS WHAT HAPPENS IF WE CHOOSE THE PLANET
scenes.action: The astronaut wrestles the controls. Wangdoo tumbles past him. The ship falls through violet clouds and crashes in dust, with a four-frame impact cut.

scenes.label: STRANDED
scenes.action: They leave the damaged ship. Wangdoo stumbles, recovers and celebrates landing, until an engine pod falls off.

scenes.label: DO NOT TOUCH
scenes.action: A friendly flower leans toward Wangdoo. He waves, sniffs and touches it despite the astronaut's warning. Its petals unfold into metal antennas and broadcast a red alarm.

scenes.label: STORY MISSION 02 · SURVIVE THE SIGNAL
scenes.action: A visible pulse runs from the flower to the ancient gate. Towers rise; a huge mechanical foot and moving shadow approach. The astronaut takes Wangdoo's flipper and pulls him away.

scenes.label: RUN
scenes.action: They dodge rocks. Wangdoo's emergency boost launches him too fast; the astronaut catches him, then carries him to an ancient terminal.

scenes.label: ONE CORE · TWO OUTPUTS
scenes.action: The terminal reveals one removable core: open the gate or power the ship's oxygen recycler. The astronaut points to the ship; Wangdoo points to the gate. Another footstep interrupts.

scenes.label: YOU CHOOSE
scenes.action: The oxygen warning falls to four percent while the machine approaches. Either choice permanently loses the other route.

scenes.label: TRY A REAL CHALLENGE
scenes.action: The engineering dilemma leads into an authentic view of AltWing's browser projects. The two risky story choices remain visible.

dialogue.text: Captain! I don't like this part!
No fuel. Almost no oxygen. You're stranded.
Okay. It does NOT like me.
Captain... I think I woke something up.
